description: Physarum/slime-mold agents seeded on the rims of packed circles, steering by sensing white trails; faint white marks on black
notable: Agents read the canvas back via getImageData each frame, so the drawn trails become the sensor field.

description: Physarum agents seeded on packed circles leave gradient trails colored per-agent; sensing runs on an offscreen buffer, optional Atkinson dither
notable: Separates a hidden trail-sensing buffer from the visible gradient-stroke render; palette drawn from mindful + auto-albers sets.

description: A 100x100 grid of colored cells that migrate along noise-chosen 8-neighbor directions each frame, wrapping at the edges
A 100x100 grid where each cell samples a color index from an animated 3D value-noise field, producing drifting color regions
Recursively subdivided horizontal bands (each block split again into sub-blocks) after a Haus Konstruktiv concrete-art work; palette recomposes every 30 frames
notable: After 'Quanten-Aequivalenz an der Horizontalen II'; oklch triadic palettes from pro-color-harmonies.

description: Same recursive band layout as pro-color, but each rectangle clips a vertically scrolling three-tone gradient so the blocks appear to shift
notable: lerpFrames drives per-rect offsets under a clip, giving a seamless looping vertical scroll within the static grid.

description: The recursive quantum-equivalence band layout colored from RYB color-mixing cubes (Itten, Goethe, Munsell, etc.); recomposes every 30 frames
notable: Picks a random historical RYB gamut cube from rybitten so hue relationships follow painterly color wheels, not RGB.

description: Quantum-equivalence band layout filled from a hand-built monochrome RYB cube swept through a full hue rainbow via t-parameterized color functions
notable: Custom 8-entry ColorCube tuned to a near-monochrome ramp, then hue-cycled to read as a tonal rainbow.

description: Quantum-equivalence band layout with colors from a random RYB gamut cube swept through 360-degree hue via t-parameterized color functions
Quantum-equivalence band layout using procedurally built RGB-biased RYB cubes (one channel ramped), hue-cycled across a rainbow
notable: Cubes are synthesized by ramping one of R/G/B while fixing the others, biasing the whole RYB mix toward a channel.

description: A self-reproducing sketch: it stores its own source and scrolls that text as an infinite carousel of monospace code lines on near-black
notable: A true quine — the string reprints itself via PLACEHOLDER escaping, and the image is literally its own code.

description: 2D raycasting: a mouse-following point emits 360 rays that terminate on random wall segments, drawn as white light rays on black
Raycast visibility among packed circles: the lit polygon is cut out of a black shadow layer with destination-out so light reveals the ground
Raycast light/shadow over a grid of rounded rectangles and circles; the emitter tracks diagonally across the canvas, lit area in bg color over fg shadow
notable: 720 rays sorted by angle build a smooth visibility polygon; WCAG-contrast filtering picks the fg/light colors.

description: 2D raycasting against random wall segments, filling the mouse-lit region as a solid translucent visibility polygon on black
A colored field cut by a black stepped-polygon shape whose vertices tween between random target configurations; portrait format
notable: Two-color (fg/bg) oklch pair from one random hue; the composition is a single morphing negative-space silhouette.

description: The red-and-black stepped silhouette animated with per-vertex spring physics toward cycling target shapes, giving overshoot and settle
The red-and-black spring silhouette with added anticipation — vertices pull back before lunging toward each new target shape
notable: Adds an anticipation phase to the spring so motion has a cartoon wind-up before the snap.

description: Drifting poisson-disc circles paired by tangent 'rubber band' outlines; each circle filled by a noise-mapped color with a bg inner dot
notable: Rubber bands are tangent-line-plus-arc wraps between circle pairs; edges assigned greedily to avoid chain topology.

description: Packed circles wrapped by one continuous rubber band with convex/concave/floater pegs, rendered as a beveled tube with an animated dashed conveyor
notable: Cheapest-insertion + 2-opt build a non-self-crossing contact cycle; role-aware tangents let the band dip into concave dents. Tweakpane controls.

description: Nested rubber-band hull outlines: several independent poisson-disc circle layers, each wrapped by its drifting convex-hull membrane
notable: Up to 12 pre-generated layers stay stable when the layer slider changes; each is an independent hull outline. Tweakpane controls.

description: Denser variant of rubber-band-stipple: drifting poisson-disc circles with many tangent rubber-band links (no orphan circles) plus stipple fills
notable: Higher connection distance plus an orphan-fixup pass yields a woven web rather than isolated pairs.

description: A hull-boundary membrane with interior circles tied to it by tendon edges, layered with stepped lightness/hue color shifts
notable: Interior nodes connect to hull-boundary nodes like a skeleton; per-layer lightness+hue steps nod to Albers color studies. Tweakpane controls.

description: Multiple clustered skeletons: circles grouped into 2-4 clusters, each with its own hull membrane and interior tendon edges, beveled
notable: Positions are partitioned into clusters, each getting a stable boundary hull and its own tendon graph. Tweakpane controls.
